title: The Ultimate Butter Chicken
headnote: Draft: The source does not specify the quantity of chicken or honey. Confirm both amounts and how much ginger-garlic paste to use in the initial marinade before preparing.

ingredientGroups.title: Chicken and marinade
items: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs, quantity unspecified
15 ml Indian lemon juice, or a blend of 45% lime, 35% lemon and 20% white or yellow grapefruit juice

ingredientGroups.title: Makhni sauce
items: 400 g Bombay onions or shallots, sliced
5 g green bird’s eye chili, chopped
1,000 g fresh San Marzano tomatoes, chopped

steps: Mix the chicken with ginger-garlic paste, kosher salt and lemon juice. Marinate for 30 minutes, then drain the juices. The source does not specify how much of the ginger-garlic paste to use at this stage.
Mix the remaining marinade ingredients and coat the chicken. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Skewer and grill over charcoal until cooked and lightly charred.
For the sauce, heat the ghee in a pot and add the cumin seeds. When they crackle, add the garlic, ginger, green chili and onions. Cook over medium heat until translucent.
Add the remaining sauce ingredients except the butter, cream, honey and kasoori methi. Cook over low heat for 30–40 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft.
Add the butter, cream, honey and kasoori methi; blend until smooth. Add the grilled chicken and adjust the salt and kasoori methi to taste.
reviewFlags: Chicken and honey quantities are missing from the source.
